tools.name: list_specs
tools.description: List every class/spec available, with the slugs used by the other tools.

tools.name: get_talents
tools.description: List the selectable talents for a class/spec (id, name, effect description, spell id, sub-tree, hero tree, choices). Call this before generate_build so you know the talent names and what each one does. Use get_spell for the full, freshest detail on any spell id.

tools.name: generate_build
tools.description: Produce a valid, importable loadout string for a class/spec. Provide talents to include (by name or id), an optional hero tree, and priority talents to fill remaining points. The solver enforces prerequisites, gates, and budgets.

tools.name: decode_build
tools.description: Decode a loadout string into its class/spec and the selected talents, each with its rank and max_ranks.

tools.name: popular_builds
tools.description: Get the importable loadout that players actually ran to kill a raid boss (or clear an M+ dungeon), aggregated from Warcraft Logs and the M+ leaderboards, for a class/spec. Pass a boss/dungeon name, or a general all-round build for the whole content: "All Bosses" for a raid (set difficulty to normal/

tools.name: get_spell
tools.description: Get the current Blizzard details for a spell — name and full effect description — by spell id (from get_talents) or by name. Data is refreshed daily, so it reflects the live patch rather than stale training data.

tools.name: get_character
tools.description: Look up a live World of Warcraft character from Blizzard's armory: profile summary (class, spec, level, item level, guild, faction) plus the sections you ask for — gear, talents, stats, M+, raid and dungeon progress, professions, PvP, achievements, collections, and more. findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_character" is 1589 chars, far longer than this server's median (246). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Look up a live World of Warcraft character from Blizzard's armory: profile summary (class, spec, level, item level, guild, faction) plus the sections you ask fo…

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "decode_build" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Decode a loadout string into its class/spec and the list of selected talents." → after: "Decode a loadout string into its class/spec and the selected talents, each with its rank and max_ranks."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
